- **Clarion Conqueror is the card that beats this deck**, and it is narrower
  than it looks in one direction and wider in another. It stops activated
  abilities of artifacts, creatures and planeswalkers only, so what it turns off
  is exactly three things: Martyr of Sands, **Kami of False Hope** - `Sacrifice
  this creature: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn` is an
  activated ability of a creature, so the fog loop dies with the lifegain engine
  and living end's stated backup plan dies with it - and the Thraben Inspector
  Clue. Mistveil Plains, both fetchlands and Emeria, the Sky Ruin are lands and
  keep working, and Abiding Grace and Emeria are triggered abilities rather than
  activated ones. It is in the recorded boards of boros energy, esper blink and
  living end. Two maindeck cards answer the Dragon itself: Skyclave Apparition
  exiles it at mana value 3, and **Solitude** exiles it outright - it is a 3/3
  with no protection, ward or hexproof, and Solitude's exile is an enters
  trigger the Conqueror does not touch. Solitude, at four copies, is the reason
  a resolved Conqueror is not the game; Skyclave is the reason it is answerable
